name: Why are multigenerational homes becoming more popular?

mainEntity.name: Why are multigenerational homes becoming more popular?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rising housing costs, desire for family support, aging-in-place needs, and cultural preferences for extended family living drive demand for homes that support privacy alongside togetherness.
